inspect_ast.description: Inspects code structure and finds target lines in source files using Tree-sitter.
inspect_ast.tip: Tip: Use templates like 'functions' or 'classes' for quick navigation.

dump_ast.description: Dumps the complete AST syntax tree of a file as S-expression text.
dump_ast.tip: Tip: For larger files, prefer using 'inspect_ast' with specific templates/queries to reduce token usage and focus on target blocks.

view_lines.description: Retrieves lines along with their persistent unique Line IDs for any text file (including source code, markdown, configuration, or plain text). Useful for target line selection.
view_lines.tip: Tip: Specify start_line and end_line range to view only relevant chunks.

edit_lines.description: Applies a structured batch of line edits (insert_after, insert_before, update, delete, replace_range, move) transactionally to any text file (including source code, markdown, configuration, or plain text). Performs syntax validation for supported programming languages.
edit_lines.tip: Tip: Always verify Line IDs before applying edits to prevent conflict.

create_lines.description: Create a new file with initial content and initialize its line editing session. Returns the line list with unique line IDs. Fails if the file already exists.
